GLS.feature.pf2e-creaturedex.title: Creaturedex
GLS.feature.pf2e-creaturedex.hint: Recall Knowledge reveals a creature's stat block one section at a time, and the party keeps what it learns.
GLDEX.settings.partyKnowledge.name: Party knowledge
GLDEX.settings.partyKnowledge.hint: Treat everything any character has learned as known to the whole party, so one member's success completes the creaturedex for everyone. Off by default: the book prints this as an optional sidebar for tables that want to encourage shared tactics. Turning it on or off never adds or destroys knowledge — it only changes how a character's dex is read.
GLDEX.settings.noSecretChecks.name: No secret checks
GLDEX.settings.noSecretChecks.hint: Drop the critical-failure effect entirely, so a bad roll simply teaches nothing instead of teaching a lie. Turn this on if your table rolls Recall Knowledge in the open: a player who can see the die cannot be fooled by it, and a lie everyone knows is a lie is just a wasted turn.
GLDEX.settings.randomSection.name: Roll for the section
GLDEX.settings.randomSection.hint: Roll 1d4 when a reveal is earned: 1-3 names the section, 4 lets the player choose. The book offers this for tables without secret checks, as a way to keep some uncertainty in the result. The die is rolled once per card, not once per viewer.
GLDEX.settings.grantAid.name: Grant Discerning Aid
GLDEX.settings.grantAid.hint: Add the Discerning Aid reaction to a character's sheet the first time they complete a creaturedex. Granted once and never taken back: the requirement is checked per creature, but the access is permanent.
GLDEX.settings.chatOffer.name: Offer reveals on Recall Knowledge cards
GLDEX.settings.chatOffer.hint: Add the section picker to a Recall Knowledge check made through PF2e's own action, resolved against whatever the roller had targeted. Every reveal is also available by hand from the dex window, so a table that rolls its skills directly loses nothing but the shortcut.
GLDEX.settings.playerAccess.name: Players may open the dex
GLDEX.settings.playerAccess.hint: Let a player open the Creaturedex from their own character sheet and read what that character has learned. Turn this off to keep the dex a GM-facing readout the table is told about rather than one they browse.
GLDEX.app.title: Creaturedex
GLDEX.app.completeNote: Creaturedex complete. Discerning Aid may be used against this creature.
GLDEX.offer.title: Creaturedex
GLDEX.offer.repeat: A repeat attempt: this creature has not taken a turn since the last one.
GLDEX.offer.falseHint: Whatever is chosen will be recorded as true and shown to the player as true.
GLDEX.forget.title: Forget this creature?
GLDEX.forget.body: Every character's knowledge of this creature is discarded, including anything recorded as false. This cannot be undone.
GLDEX.aid.name: Discerning Aid
GLDEX.aid.text:
Trigger An ally would target a creature or hazard with an effect requiring a skill check, attack roll or saving throw, or would be targeted by one of its effects.

Requirements You have completed the creaturedex of the triggering creature or hazard.

Attempt a Recall Knowledge check against the standard DC of that creature's level. Your result grants the same circumstance bonus the Aid reaction would, applied to your ally's check or to the DC they are rolling against, and imposes the same penalty on a critical failure. The bonus increases if you are a master or legendary in the skill you used.

This counts as the Aid reaction for every purpose.
